name: name
doc: the name that is exposed to lua functions that spawn entities. Usually a $biome_ translation key

name: type
doc: Generator: BIOME_PROCEDURAL (cave noise), BIOME_BITMAP (bitmap_filename), BIOME_WANG_TILE (wang_template_file)

name: background_image
doc: path to the image file (texture) that is used for the background

name: background_edge_left
doc: if not empty, will use this image as the left edge

name: background_edge_right
doc: if not empty, will use this image as the right edge

name: background_edge_top
doc: if not empty, will use this image as the top edge

name: background_edge_bottom
doc: if not empty, will use this image as the bottom edge

name: background_edge_priority
doc: if both biomes have edges defined, will use the one with higher priority (if priority is same, will compare (>) background_images)

name: background_use_neighbor
doc: if set will look for neighboring biomes and use their background image

name: background_image_height
doc: height were the background image starts

name: limit_background_image
doc: Will limit the background image to start at the cave height

name: bitmap_noise_file
doc: if set, loads it to mBitmapNoise

name: noise_biome_edges
doc: does the noisy edge for biomes, if either of biomes has this set to 0 will do a straight edge

name: big_noise_biome_edges
doc: if true, will leak onto other biomes and not be carveable

name: fat_biome_edges
doc: if true, will leak onto other biomes and not be carveable

name: skip_edge_textures
doc: skips edge texture generation. Turn of for pixel scenes

name: audio_music_enter
doc: the music event that plays when player enters this biome (e.g. 'music/desert/enter')

name: audio_music_2
doc: the music directory that plays while player is in this biome (e.g 'coalmine')

name: audio_music_energy_coeff
doc: Multiplier for music energy in this biome

name: audio_music_no_forced_quietness
doc: If 1, music is not quieted by occasional quietness

name: audio_music_forced_quietness_duration_seconds
doc: If > 0, this is the duration of occasional quietness, else the value from magic numbers is used.

name: audio_music_trigger_without_danger
doc: If 1, music is triggered in this biome no matter what the danger level is

name: audio_ambience
doc: the ambience event that plays while player is in this biome

name: audio_ambience_surface
doc: the ambience event that plays while player is in this biome and on surface

name: color_grading_r
doc: post fx color grading

name: color_grading_g
doc: post fx color grading

name: color_grading_b
doc: post fx color grading

name: color_grading_grayscale
doc: post fx color grading. [0.0,1.0], larger value means more grayscale

name: has_rain
doc: if 1, rain or snowfall may occur in this biome

name: fog_of_war_type
doc: the way removing fog of war works in this biome

name: sunset_alpha_target
doc: affects sunset gradient amount

name: bitmap_filename
doc: loads the chunk from this bitmap, the bitmap should be 512x512

name: wang_template_file
doc: uses this file to create a herringbone wang map

name: wang_map_width
doc: the size of the wang map (range 1..512)

name: wang_map_height
doc: the size of the wang map (range 1..512)

name: lua_script
doc: default is data/scripts/biomes/NAME.lua

name: pixel_scene
doc: for 'pixel scene' biomes, this forces the loading before hand

name: static_tile
doc: if 1, directly blits wang_template_file without wang randomization, kind of like a pixel scene but at the wang tile resolution

name: static_tile_bg_mask
doc: if set, and static tile is 1, the background_image will use a special shader and this mask to calculate visiblity. should be same size and resolution as 'wang_template_file'

name: static_tile_bg_mask_threshold
doc: threshold used in 'sprite_static_tile_bg.frag' shader in conjuction with 'sprite_static_tile_bg_mask' to determine if a background pixel is visible or not

name: game_enemy_hp_scale
doc: 1.f = default. Will multiply the hp of the camerabounded enemies in the area with hp_scale

name: game_enemy_attack_speed
doc: 1.f = default. This multiplies AnimalAI's attack_ranged_frames_between in camerabounded enemies

name: noise_type
doc: the style of the cave noise

name: mInsideNoiseType
doc: the style of the inside noise

name: mInsideNoiseFBM
doc: will fbm the mInsideNoise if set true

name: mInsidePerlinScaleX
doc: the noise inside the stones...

name: mInsidePerlinScaleY
doc: the noise inside the stones...

name: mInsidePerlinForceInside
doc: if set, will multiply the noise_value with the gradient value

name: mInsidePerlinOffsetBySeed
doc: NOTE( Petri ): 17.8.2023 - if set, will add worldseed as an offset to the noise

name: mInsidePerlinOffsetX
doc: NOTE( Petri ): 17.8.2023 - perlin noise offset

name: mInsidePerlinOffsetY
doc: NOTE( Petri ): 17.8.2023 - perlin noise offset

name: mInsideAddValue
doc: added inside the caves the gradient value

name: mMultiplierGradient
doc: how much of the gradient is applied

name: mMultiplierPerlin
doc: how much of the inside noise

name: mGradientSlopeStartX
doc: if addNoise = 3, will use this to the ( x - mGradientSlopeStartX ) * mGradientSlopeDelta

name: mGradientSlopeDelta
doc: if addNoise = 3, will use this to the ( x - mGradientSlopeStartX ) * mGradientSlopeDelta

name: mGradientAddNoise
doc: fake enum 1=standard noise, 2=fbm noise, 3=slope

name: coarse_map_force_terrain
doc: if 1, is initially marked as 'terrain' in the coarse map used for sky light calculations etc

name: coarse_map_not_terrain
doc: if 1, is initially never marked as 'terrain' in the coarse map used for sky light calculations etc

name: coarse_map_cell_count_always_zero
doc: if 1, areas in this biome always have a 64x64 cell count of 0
